notisMsg1: The square in your neighbourhood is changing: tall trees, water, earth instead of concrete. The plan passed unanimously last night.
notisMsg3: Not officially — the regulations require plastic flooring and do not allow trees. There will be play equipment in natural materials, and a proper playground was requested elsewhere.
notisMsg5: €150,000, from a European urban cooling programme. The deadline is the end of 2027.
notisMsg7: Alright, I'll stop. If you change your mind, write to me.
notisBeat1: He reads your community council too, not only the municipal one.
notisBeat2: You ask — and you get short answers.
notisBeat3: He answers from the minutes, not from nowhere.
notisBeat4: The figures and the deadlines, without looking anything up.
notisBeat5: One word stops it. No small print.
